description: Haarlemmerdijk 19th-c. shop houses with WIDE multi-light windows under a neck or bell gable: two axes, each a wide window of a centre light between narrow side lights under a top light, over a tall shop ground; 3.2-7 m fronts, eaves 8.8-10.6 m (Haarlemmerdijk 131, 133A)

match.note: Haarlemmerdijk 117-143 (2022-12-15 strip, 1 m grid): 131 rows 4.8-6.3 / 6.6-8.4 m under a cornice 9.3-9.9 m; 133A rows 5.0-6.6 / 6.9-8.2 m under a neck gable from 9.2 m. Each axis is one wide window of three lights under a top light, which measureFacade reads as 2-4 columns (5-7 over the front): columnsPerBay [2, 4]. Two axes whatever the width. crownMatch/crownStrict off as the rest of the library: reviewer crown pins decide
